name: @w6w-apps/canny
description: Manage posts, boards, votes, comments, tags and users on Canny — the product feedback and feature request platform.

w6w.longDescription:
Canny collects product feedback: users post feature requests on a board, vote and comment on the ones they care about, and your team triages, tags, categorizes and moves posts through a status pipeline — then tells everyone what shipped in a changelog. This app covers that whole loop from a workflow: read and search posts and boards, create posts and comments on a user's behalf, move a post through status/category/board changes, tag it, merge duplicates, and cast or remove votes.

It also covers the two records every automation eventually needs: users (Canny's own identity, keyed by your application's userID or a Canny-issued id) and companies (the account a user belongs to, with custom fields and MRR) — both upserted and read the same way Canny's own SSO/Identify integrations do. A changelog entry action lets a workflow publish a release note the moment a linked post's status changes, and a status-change feed lets a workflow react to the whole team's triage activity instead of one post at a time.

Canny's API is authenticated with one secret, workspace-wide API key — there is no per-token scoping — sent as an `apiKey` field in the JSON body of every POST, never as a header or query string. Every path, argument and response field here was read off Canny's own generated API reference (developers.canny.io) rather than a third-party directory.
